title: 🚨MAJOR BUY: Last EASY Wealth Opportunity For Decades
creator: Tom Nash
summary: Tom Nash frames the past month's sell-off - S&P 500 down 7%, Nasdaq down 11%, Nvidia down 31.5%, fear-and-greed index at 9 - as one of the greatest long-term buying opportunities, arguing bear markets (27 in 100 years, averaging a 35% drop over 10 months) have always led to new all-time highs. His evidence: the S&P 500 forward P/E has fallen from 23 to 17, below the 10-year average of 19, while earnings grow 32-33% versus an 8% average; high rates and extreme fear mean a bubble cannot form; and the AI capex cycle is just starting, with cloud backlogs around $2 trillion and Google Cloud growing 103%, Azure 48% and AWS 40%. He dismisses the fear list - the Nvidia scandal, new tariffs, Democrats killing AI, capex, a December rate rise and the Iran war - as noise that does not touch fundamentals. His one named call is Amazon (AMZN), his new 'eight-year stock': revenue doubled in five years, operating income tripled (the intro says quadrupled - the captions are inconsistent), forward P/E compressed from 56 to 17 and price-to-sales from 3.5 to 3.3. He also teases a second, never-before-mentioned 'S-tier' stock but withholds the ticker behind an email signup, so no second call can be extracted. AMD, CrowdStrike and Arista Networks appear only as performance examples from his Patreon top-36 list (30 of 36 up since April 2025, averaging +73% versus the S&P's +41.5%), not as new recommendations. Some figures are garbled in the auto-captions.
